evidence.quote: We followed the Masked Diffusion Language Model (MDLM) [34] workflow to define the absorbing-state forward diffusion process
For guided generation, we set a total of 256 steps for the model to generate
Its generative module accepts our pathogen knowledge-informed antimicrobial prediction as conditional signals and outputs candidate SELFIES strings
we curated a diverse dataset of 121.6 million unique sequences from PubChem
We utilize Me-LLaMA [18] to obtain embeddings for pathogen strain description texts
The MIC regressor from the ApexOrcale as well as a peptide classifier trained on our DLM training data were used as guided predictors
by conditioning its generative module on pathogen embeddings and guiding it with the internal activity predictor
